questions.prompt: Which kind of work makes cost hardest to predict, per OpenAI's admin FAQ?

options.explanation: OpenAI's highest-variance list is about frequent, large, multi-tool work, not short questions.

options.text: Writing one email with no tools or files
options.explanation: One short email with no tools is not on OpenAI's list of highest-variance patterns.
